"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"With Republican leadership, Congress recently passed legislation that begins to reverse America's military decline.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The National Defense Authorization Act of 2016 begins to correct shortfalls in military readiness by reversing troop cuts, increasing investments in training and maintenance, and rebuilding facilities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The National Defense Authorization Act of 2016 gives troops the full pay raise to which they are entitled under the law.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The National Defense Authorization Act of 2016 gives the next administration the ability to review operations and funding, make adjustments, and ask for more money if necessary.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Military families must be assured of the pay, healthcare, housing, education, and overall support they have earned.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Military families have been carrying the burden of budgetary restraint more than any other Americans through cuts in their pay, health benefits, and retirement plans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"About 75 percent of enlistees come from military families.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Continued patriotic commitment among young people is not expected if they experience the way their families have been treated.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
